# Swift Conventions

Conventions for Swift code under `swift/`.

<!-- BEGIN_TABLE: generated by scripts/generate-conventions-index.py, edits inside will be overwritten -->

| Convention | File |
| --- | --- |
| Swift apps may depend on reusable libraries but not other apps; shared implementation belongs in swift/libs rather than copied app sources. | [apps-depend-on-libs-only](../conventions/swift/apps-depend-on-libs-only.md) |
| Keep SwiftUI views declarative: pass display values and actions; put networking, persistence, and coordination in feature-owned state. | [declarative-views](../conventions/swift/declarative-views.md) |
| Represent mutually exclusive Swift feature states with associated-value enums and exhaustive switches, not independent flags and nullable payloads. | [exhaustive-state-enums](../conventions/swift/exhaustive-state-enums.md) |
| Make Swift UI state actor isolation explicit and use Sendable values across concurrency boundaries instead of unchecked isolation escapes. | [explicit-actor-isolation](../conventions/swift/explicit-actor-isolation.md) |
| Change iOS targets and build settings in the checked-in project specification; regenerate the Xcode project rather than editing generated project files. | [generated-project-inputs](../conventions/swift/generated-project-inputs.md) |
| Fix Swift ownership and type design before adding casts, type erasure, compiler escapes, or lint suppressions; isolate proven external limitations narrowly. | [improve-types-before-suppression](../conventions/swift/improve-types-before-suppression.md) |
| Inject Swift feature collaborators at composition boundaries instead of using global services; introduce protocols only for a concrete substitution or abstraction need. | [injected-collaborators](../conventions/swift/injected-collaborators.md) |
| Design Swift APIs for clarity at the call site using Swift naming and access control, rather than translating Python or TypeScript spelling mechanically. | [swift-api-design](../conventions/swift/swift-api-design.md) |
| Propagate Swift failures and cancellation explicitly; do not turn failed work into nil, empty data, or success with try? or catch-all fallbacks. | [transparent-errors-and-cancellation](../conventions/swift/transparent-errors-and-cancellation.md) |
| Decode external values into validated Codable or domain types at ingress; keep Any dictionaries, casts, and empty-value sentinels out of business logic. | [typed-domain-boundaries](../conventions/swift/typed-domain-boundaries.md) |
| Use Swift structs and enums for domain values; use reference types for real identity or shared observation, without speculative inheritance. | [value-semantics-first](../conventions/swift/value-semantics-first.md) |

<!-- END_TABLE -->
